name: Spring Planting Setup: Corn & Soybean Seasonal Analysis (2021–2026)
description: Research study analyzing the spring planting setup for ZC (corn) and ZS (soybean) futures over 2021–2026. Three components: (1) Seasonal price path analysis comparing 2026 YTD vs historical 4-year average indexed to 100 on Jan 1, with summary statistics. (2) ZS/ZC price ratio time series with reference levels at 2.3 (corn-favored), 2.5 (neutral), 2.8 (soy-favored). (3) Supply-demand context via FRED agricultural indicators: global corn price, global soybean price, and PPI Grains index.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SPRING PLANTING SETUP: CORN & SOYBEAN SEASONAL ANALYSIS (2021–2026)
# =============================================================================
# Component 1: Seasonal price path per asset (2026 YTD vs 2021–2025 avg, indexed to 100)
# Component 2: ZS/ZC price ratio with key reference levels
# Component 3: FRED agricultural supply-demand proxies (global corn/soy prices, PPI Grains)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Source: primary futures with continuation ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# --- Datetime extraction ---
ts = index()
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
day_of_year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_year)(ts)

# =============================================================================
# COMPONENT 1: SEASONAL PRICE PATH ANALYSIS (per asset)
# =============================================================================

# Year-open price: first close of each year, forward-filled
is_new_year = year_num != (year_num >> 1)
yr_open = ffill(where(is_new_year, close))

# Index price to 100 on Jan 1 of each year
indexed_price = close / yr_open * 100

# Split: 2026 current vs historical 2021-2025 average
is_2026 = year_num == 2026
is_hist = (year_num >= 2021) and (year_num <= 2025)

current_path = where(is_2026, indexed_price)
hist_path = where(is_hist, indexed_price)

# Seasonal price path chart
xy_lines(
    title='Seasonal Price Path: 2026 vs Historical Average',
    category='1. Seasonal Price Path',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Price (Jan 1 = 100)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfYear,
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=False,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=100.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Jan 1 Base')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2026 (Current)', color=Color.Blue, agg=AggregationType.Last),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Historical Avg (2021-2025)', color=Color.Gray, agg=AggregationType.Mean)
    ]),
    order=1
)(day_of_year, current_path, hist_path)

# --- Summary Statistics ---
# YTD return (percent)
ytd_ret = where(is_2026, close / yr_open - 1)

# 52-week (252-day) high and low
high_52w = max(period=252)(close)
low_52w = min(period=252)(close)

# Current seasonal level vs 5-year average at the same day_of_year
# (The hist_path mean aggregation in the chart handles this; for the table
#  we show the latest indexed value vs the historical avg line)
current_indexed = where(is_2026, indexed_price)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Seasonal Summary Statistics',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Current Price', '52-Week High / Low', 'YTD Return', 'Current Indexed Level (Jan 1=100)'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Price', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='52-Week High', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='YTD Return', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Indexed Level', grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Seasonal Price Path',
    order=2
)(close, high_52w, ytd_ret, current_indexed)

# =============================================================================
# COMPONENT 2: CORN/SOYBEAN PRICE RATIO (ZS/ZC)
# =============================================================================
# Load the other futures contract via reference_futures
# For ZC asset: load ZS reference; for ZS asset: load ZC reference
# Compute ratio = ZS price / ZC price in both cases

ref_zs = reference_futures(ticker="ZS")()
ref_zc = reference_futures(ticker="ZC")()

# Use is_asset_ref to determine which asset we're on
is_zc = is_asset_ref(ticker="ZC")()
is_zs = is_asset_ref(ticker="ZS")()

# Soybean price and corn price for ratio calculation
# On ZC: soy = ref_zs.c, corn = close (own data)
# On ZS: soy = close (own data), corn = ref_zc.c
soy_price = where(is_zc, ref_zs.c, where(is_zs, close, 0.0 / 0.0))
corn_price = where(is_zc, close, where(is_zs, ref_zc.c, 0.0 / 0.0))

# ZS/ZC ratio
ratio = soy_price / corn_price

# 5-year percentile rank of the ratio (using ~1260 trading days)
ratio_pctrank = percentrank(period=1260)(ratio)

# Ratio time series chart
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean/Corn Price Ratio (ZS÷ZC)',
    category='2. Soybean/Corn Ratio',
    y_axis_label='ZS/ZC Ratio',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=False,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.3, color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='2.3 (Corn Favored)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='2.5 (Neutral)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.8, color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='2.8 (Soy Favored)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZS/ZC Ratio', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, ratio)

# Ratio summary table
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Soybean/Corn Ratio Analysis',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Current Ratio', '5-Year Avg Ratio', 'Percentile vs 5Y Range'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Ratio', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='5Y Avg', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Percentile', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. Soybean/Corn Ratio',
    order=2
)(ratio, ratio, ratio_pctrank)

# =============================================================================
# COMPONENT 3: SUPPLY-DEMAND INDICATORS (FRED proxies)
# =============================================================================
# WASDE ending stocks not directly on FRED; using nearest proxies:
#   PMAIZMTUSDM = Global Corn Price (monthly, $/metric ton)
#   PSOYBUSDM   = Global Soybean Price (monthly, $/metric ton)
#   WPU012      = PPI Farm Products: Grains (monthly, index)

corn_global = economic_indicators(series_id="PMAIZMTUSDM", use_alfred=False)()
soy_global = economic_indicators(series_id="PSOYBUSDM", use_alfred=False)()
ppi_grains = economic_indicators(series_id="WPU012", use_alfred=False)()

# Forward-fill sparse monthly data to every daily bar
corn_gp = ffill(corn_global.result)
soy_gp = ffill(soy_global.result)
grains_ppi = ffill(ppi_grains.result)

# Prior month values (lag by ~22 trading days for monthly data)
corn_gp_prior = corn_gp >> 22
soy_gp_prior = soy_gp >> 22
grains_ppi_prior = grains_ppi >> 22

# Month-over-month change
corn_mom = (corn_gp - corn_gp_prior) / corn_gp_prior
soy_mom = (soy_gp - soy_gp_prior) / soy_gp_prior
grains_mom = (grains_ppi - grains_ppi_prior) / grains_ppi_prior

# 5-year percentile rank (~1260 days)
corn_gp_pct = percentrank(period=1260)(corn_gp)
soy_gp_pct = percentrank(period=1260)(soy_gp)
grains_ppi_pct = percentrank(period=1260)(grains_ppi)

# Supply-demand indicator chart: plot all three on same chart
xy_lines(
    title='Agricultural Supply-Demand Indicators (FRED)',
    category='3. Supply-Demand Context',
    y_axis_label='Index Value',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=False,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Global Corn Price ($/MT)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Global Soybean Price ($/MT)', color=Color.Indigo),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='PPI Grains (Index)', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, corn_gp, soy_gp, grains_ppi)

# Supply-demand summary table
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Supply-Demand Summary',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Global Corn ($/MT)', 'Global Soybeans ($/MT)', 'PPI Grains (Index)'],
        col_headers=['Latest', 'Prior Month', 'MoM Change', '5Y Percentile'],
        cells=[
            # Corn row
            ColumnSpec(title='Corn Latest', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Corn Prior', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Corn MoM', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Corn Pct', grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            # Soybean row
            ColumnSpec(title='Soy Latest', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Soy Prior', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Soy MoM', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Soy Pct', grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            # PPI Grains row
            ColumnSpec(title='PPI Latest', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='PPI Prior', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='PPI MoM', grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='PPI Pct', grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Supply-Demand Context',
    order=2
)(corn_gp, corn_gp_prior, corn_mom, corn_gp_pct, soy_gp, soy_gp_prior, soy_mom, soy_gp_pct, grains_ppi, grains_ppi_prior, grains_mom, grains_ppi_pct)
